outcome: Duration of pregnancy (gestational age at delivery)
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women at 23rd to 25th gestational week, enrolled in Kerbala maternity teaching hospital between January and April 2019.
finding: Vitamin B12 deficiency was significantly associated with lower blood hemoglobin levels in mothers and impacted the birth weight of the child.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken between January 2019 and April 2019, when participants were at 23rd to 25th gestational week.
birth_weight: Child birth weight was recorded as an outcome.
gest_age: Participants were included at 23rd to 25th gestational week, and duration of pregnancy (average weeks of child delivery) was recorded as an outcome.
